title: Add a Blueprint layout shell
description: Copy one layout shell from files/layout/ (the same catalog `preset` draws from) into an existing project, wire it into app.routes.ts, and add the UI components it needs.

name.description: Layout folder name under files/layout/ (e.g. sidebar-shell).

wireRoutes.description: Sweep the project's existing top-level routes under this shell (wrapRoutesUnderLayout) and wire the welcome screen as its index route. Default true for the four main app shells. Set false for a content-only shell that must not become the app's root wrapper (e.g. modules:auth's auth-split/auth-centered, which wire their own routes separately via addLayoutBranch).

withAccountMenu.description: Add the user-menu/theme-switcher (+ language-switcher) account-menu family. Default true for the four main app shells. Set false for a shell with no signed-in user yet (e.g. an auth shell).
